prompt_text: Who is the best mortgage lender in St. Louis MO for a home purchase loan?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one universally “best” lender—the right choice depends on your credit, down payment, loan type, and whether you qualify for assistance. **For a practical starting point, compare USA Mortgage, a local bank or credit union, and one independent mortgage broker.** USA Mortgage is a prominent local option with a broad range of loan programs; Midwest BankCentre advertises local decision-making and dedicated service. Those are starting points, not proof either will offer your best rate.

If you may qualify for Missouri down-payment or closing-cost assistance, ask lenders whether they’re certified to offer **MHDC** programs. MHDC says its programs are available through certified lenders and include assistance options for eligible buyers.

Get written **Loan Estimates** from at least three lenders for the same loan type, down payment, rate-lock period, and closing date. Compare the interest rate, APR, lender fees, points, mortgage insurance, and estimated cash to close—not just the monthly payment. Ask each lender how quickly they can issue a preapproval and whether they can meet your target closing date.

If you share your approximate purchase price, down payment, credit range, and whether you’re a first-time buyer or veteran, I can suggest which loan types and lender questions to prioritize.
